_about: Non-LEGO hardware: stand-in parts under data/ldraw/parts (see tools/hardware_parts.py). Each placed stand-in is a line on the hardware list, not the LEGO parts lists; 'part_of' ones are counted with that item. price = [low, high] USD each, rough.

bk-clock-insert-35mm.name: Mini quartz clock insert, 1-3/8" (35 mm) fit-up
bk-clock-insert-35mm.description: Press-in quartz clock movement with its own dial, hands and button cell, made for a 35 mm (1-3/8") hole: 35 mm body, a bezel of about 36-38 mm, 15-20 mm deep including the setting knob. White dial, black numerals.
bk-clock-insert-35mm.where: Clock-making and woodworking suppliers (Klockit, Rockler, Woodcraft), craft stores, Amazon or eBay: search for "1-3/8 inch mini clock insert" or "35 mm clock insert".
